coursework.en: No blanket ban on AI in ordinary courses was found. According to Fudan's official announcement, the January 2026 teaching guide allows AI for supporting steps such as language polishing and structural suggestions but not for core academic work, and expects course syllabi to set AI conditions. The stricter undergraduate-thesis rule applies to course, term and exam papers only where no specific rule exists ('may refer to').
coursework.zh: 未发现普通课程全面禁止 AI 的规定。据复旦官方报道，2026 年 1 月的教学应用指引允许在语言润色、结构建议等辅助环节使用 AI，但不得替代核心学术劳动，并要求课程大纲明确 AI 使用条件。更严格的本科毕业论文规定仅在“无具体针对性规定”时可供课程论文、学年论文和考试论文“参照执行”。

exams.en: No general exam AI rule was found; exam papers may refer to the undergraduate-thesis rule where no specific rule exists. Follow each course and exam's instructions.

disclosure.en: For undergraduate theses, any AI use must be disclosed in the thesis commitment form: tool name and version, time and purpose, what the AI produced, where it was used, plus keeping pre-AI materials for inspection. The 2026 teaching guide, as reported, judges integrity mainly on honest disclosure and process records.
disclosure.zh: 本科毕业论文中使用 AI，必须在承诺书中披露：工具名称和版本、使用时间与用途、AI 生成的内容或建议、在论文中的使用部分，并保留 AI 处理前的重要材料以备检查。据报道，2026 年教学指引主要依据是否如实披露和有无过程记录判断学术诚信。

privacy_data.en: Undergraduate theses involving confidential content may not use any AI tool or upload any data or images to AI platforms. No broader university AI data rule was found in the reviewed sources; the AI Service Hall states it uses a locally deployed model to protect data (not independently verified).
privacy_data.zh: 涉及保密内容的本科毕业论文禁止使用任何 AI 工具，禁止向 AI 平台上传任何数据和图片。所审核来源中未发现更广泛的全校 AI 数据规则；AI 办事大厅称采用本地化部署模型保护数据（未经独立核实）。

approved_tools.en: Fudan's AI Service Hall (eHall, March 2025) provides administrative services through modules 复小搜 (search) and 复小填 (form filling, three initial service items); 复小信 is an earlier Q&A assistant from 2021. research_publication.en: The AI thesis rule covers undergraduate theses only and expressly excludes published papers and research activities, which are governed by other rules. academic_integrity.en: In undergraduate theses AI may only assist (with supervisor consent) with literature search, chart suggestions, non-innovative code and reference formatting, and is banned for research design, data, key figures, writing text, language polishing and translation. Breaches are handled by seriousness, from the thesis grade or barring the defence to discipline and degree consequences only where misconduct is found. Disciplinary decisions can be appealed to the University Student Appeals Committee within 10 days, then to the Shanghai Municipal Education Commission within 15 days.

teaching_guidance.en: According to Fudan's official announcement (the full guide on the AI3A platform was not independently reviewed), the Generative AI Education and Teaching Application Guide 1.0 allows AI for auxiliary steps such as language polishing and structural suggestions, but prohibits replacing core academic work (research conception, theory building, and data analysis). This teaching guidance does not override stricter undergraduate thesis prohibitions against AI text writing, polishing, and translation.
